description: BIShare is free. Nearby transfers have no size caps and no account; remote share links and rooms are free too. No sign-up, no subscriptions.
heading: Free. All of it.

included.network: Unlimited transfers on your own network — no size caps
included.e2e: End-to-end encrypted, device to device, no server
included.links: Remote share links, QR, and 6-character codes
included.rooms: Rooms — share with a group over a short code
included.platforms: iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, and Linux

ctaNote: BIShare is transfer-only today, and it's free. Paid tiers with more cloud storage may come later — local transfers will stay free.
